text:
jordan: Heads up — PR 21984 is ready for merge but CI is stuck in the macOS e2e queue. Can we hold until reruns clear? Also there's scheduled region maintenance Fri (Mar 20) — prefer to land before maintenance or wait until after? cc @kai :eyes:

kai: Thanks. What's failing on mac specifically? Last run shows a flaky e2e timeout. If we can't get green before Fri, I'd prefer to delay until after maintenance to avoid redeploy churn.

alex: I can rebase and push a tiny fix for the flaky selector tomorrow AM. Does this PR need additional approvals before we try again? @maria

maria: I left review comments but I'm fine approving once the timeout mitigation is added (reduce wait from 10s -> 3s and add explicit selector check). After that I'll re-approve.

jordan: Good call. Also note there's a deploy-freeze Fri 18:00 -> Mon 08:00 PT, so landing right before the freeze is risky. If we fix and get green, maybe schedule for post-maintenance canary.

kai: Agreed. Let's target post-maintenance. Tag the PR as "post-maintenance" and plan a low-weight canary. I'll coordinate the rollout.

alex: I'll push the change in ~2h and trigger /rerun-ci. Pinging @devops-bot for a priority rerun if queue looks long.

devops-bot: devops-bot: CI rerun requested for PR 21984 by alex. Queue position: 12. Estimated start ~35m.

jordan: Thanks. If the queue doesn't clear by EOD we'll postpone. @sre-oncall any objections to delaying until Tue morning?

sre-oncall: No objections. Please add a short note in the PR description about the maintenance window and canary plan so infra knows the intended timing.

alex: Updated PR description with maintenance + canary notes and pushed. Locally ran `./scripts/test -k flaky_selector -rX` — passed. /rerun-ci again.

devops-bot: devops-bot: CI rerun started for PR 21984. macOS e2e: running.

maria: I'll re-check once CI passes. :thumbsup:

kai: If it's green, we still hold merge until Tue 09:00 PT. I'll coordinate canary rollout then and set low traffic weight.

jordan: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll move PR to "hold/post-maintenance" label and follow up Tue morning for final go/no-go.
